text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Alright. That's all the equipment, and we've gathered all the props for the next project too.
Now, what about the things I ordered online...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Lately, she has been extremely busy. Aside from her daily training, her recent stream projects have been quite elaborate as well.
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Want me to take on a little more for you?
Are you okay? I can take on a little more for you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you!
Don't worry though, you're already helping me plenty♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Reaction to the last video... and compilation done!
A lot of my channel members are busy people, so maybe I should make a few more shorts after all.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(While I look into this stuff a bit...
I need to pick a thumbnail for the next stream, tally the song requests, and edit the video I shot yesterday—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'm ho――... Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD! —CRASH-BASH-THUD!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...!! Are these... books!?
Aaaah, it's an avalanche...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Gasp! Where's Chrono-chan?
Chrono-chaaan! Where are youuu!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—Ex... cuse... meee...
—...Over—... here...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry,
and thank you so much for digging me out...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No, I should be the one apologizing!
I was looking away and didn't notice the pile of books!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just that! It's my fault for spreading
out so many materials. I just got carried away...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about that!
More importantly, these important documents are a total mess...!!
Let's just get this cleaned up!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Good work. I made some hot cocoa~.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you so much, again and again...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"What were you up to today, Chrono-chan?
Doing some research?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... Actually, I purchased a book written by a famous Trainer. While it explains the methodology for winning very logicallyâ

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It also described your own past and stories about the Umamusume
you've trained. As I was reading it,
I became curious about all sorts of things.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, so is that why you started digging through the documents?
I'm guessing all of those from earlier are related to that Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. By cross-referencing race data of the Umamusume in their care
with newspaper articles from that time,
I've been tracing their footsteps and methods...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: …………Um, excuse me?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Fufu. I just feel like I'm coming back to life, somehow.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: You see, I've been kind of busy lately. Of course, it's fulfilling and fun, but... things get pretty hectic, you know?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Still... whenever I spend time with Chrono-chan, it feels like I can finally catch my breath.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Drinking hot cocoa together by your side like this,
chatting leisurely in this peaceful moment—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "It's so comforting, I can really feel the warm love. Knowing this is here is what gets me through every day," you know?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: —I suppose so, yes.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, I'm embarrassed to say this,
but I haven't eaten anything since last night.
I only just realized it a moment ago."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Loves-chan,
I was able to catch my breath. So—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I............ feel the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum~♪
I wonder what today's training will be?
choice_data_list: You're busy every day, but... you seem well, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu. That's right, Chrono-chan and I were, last night—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Oops, that's a secret!
My special time with Chrono-chan
belongs only to the two of us ♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I don't quite understand, but as long as she gets
along with her roommate, that's what matters.
It warmed my heart to see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally, she'd be exhausted from such busy days,
but... far from just being energetic, she looks as if she's 'well-rested.'

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse!
Because I'm overflowing with looove♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
As long as you have love, endless energy
will well up inside you no matter how busy you are♪
